title: Pregnancy/Maternity Leave

eligibility.who: Pregnant employees: 4 months of paid leave (1 month before the due date, 3 months after), 100% of salary paid 50/50 by the employer and the CCSS

text:
The maternity leave entitlement in Costa Rica allows an employee 4 months of paid leave: 1 month before the estimated due date of the child and 3 months after the birth.
Maternity leave is paid at 100% of the employee's salary: 50% by the employer and 50% by the CCSS (Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social).
